firm_data.firm_description: Teigland-Hunt LLP provides transactional and regulatory advice to market participants. They offer expertise in the negotiation of documentation across a wide range of transactions and navigate clients through financial regulation.
notable_facts: Developed the T-H Tracker to help clients more efficiently manage and analyze their trading agreements.
Attorneys regularly participate in industry efforts to develop and enhance standardized documentation across the financial markets.
technology_signals: T-H Tracker for managing and analyzing trading agreements

email.subject: AI for Teigland-Hunt LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Ryan,

I noticed Teigland-Hunt built the T-H Tracker to help clients manage and analyze trading agreements more efficiently. That kind of thinking about workflow optimization is exactly what we see in the best firms.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on transactional work and regulatory matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
